programs.title: A Working Man
programs.desc: Former Royal Marines Levon Cade (Jason Statham) leaves his military career to lead the life of a construction worker.His plans for a peaceful retirement as a foreman are disrupted by the news of the abduction of his boss's (Michael Pena) teenage daughter, Jenny Garcia (Arianna Rivas).The girl became a victim of the Russian mafia led by Kharchenko (Andrei Kaminsky).Levon initially refuses to get involved in the case, but after consulting with his old friend, he decides to take up arms again.He uses his experience and contacts to save the hostage.The mission turns into a real massacre.The film's script was co-written by Sylwester Stallone.

programs.title: Destiny
programs.desc: The development of science and the emergence of time travel provide a chance to avoid the largest bomb attack in history.The explosion had occurred in New York ten years earlier.The risky task is undertaken by a secret government agency headed by Robertson.He realizes the danger.Since any interference with past events can irreversibly change the present, he develops a plan to eliminate the terrorist without side effects.He chooses a random agent to carry out the mission.He is to recruit a younger version of the criminal into his organization.At the same time, he makes surprising discoveries about himself.

programs.title: 30 days of darkness
programs.desc: The town of Barrow, Alaska, goes dark for thirty days every year.Most residents leave their homes at this time.The safety of those who decided to stay is ensured by young sheriff Eben Olsen (Josh Hartnett).He is struggling with serious personal problems.His marriage with Stella (Melissa George) is in crisis and she wants to leave him.Soon, however, they must unite their forces and fight the vampires who attack a town cut off from the world and plunged in darkness.Hungry monsters launch a bloody hunt for people imprisoned in Barrow.Eben, Stella and a handful of survivors begin their fight for survival.They do everything to wait for the end of the polar night.Adapted from a comic book by Steve Niles and Ben Templesmith.

programs.title: This is the end
programs.desc: A series of paranormal events take place in Los Angeles, reminiscent of the end of the world.As a result of the chaos in the city, a group of friends are trapped in an apartment.Unfortunately, their situation is becoming more and more dramatic by the minute: they are running out of food and free space, which gives rise to conflicts.Finally, having no other choice, they decide to leave the apartment and face the chaos outside.The wacky comedy is the directorial debut of two comedians: Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg.In addition to brilliant humor, the film is full of fierce irony directed at American celebrities.The main roles were played by: James Franco ("Citizen Milk", "127 Hours"), Jonah Hill ("Moneyball", "The Wolf of Wall Street"), Danny McBride ("Divine Chillout", the series "It Could Be Worse"), Emma Watson ("Harry Potter") and singer Rihanna.

programs.title: The Inventor
programs.desc: The brilliant inventor Leonardo da Vinci cannot satisfy his enormous curiosity about the world.In search of inspiration, he leaves Italy and lives at the French court, where he can freely experiment by inventing flying machines, amazing vehicles and examining the human body.He comes up with the idea of ​​creating an ideal city and, together with the adventurous and bold Princess Margaret, tries to convince the ruler of his vision.Together they are also looking for answers about the meaning of life.However, the king expects something down-to-earth from the artist and researcher - he wants a large statue to show the world his power.

programs.title: Legend of the Boneknapper Dragon
programs.desc: Gobber is convinced that the legendary dragon Gnatochrup is behind the burning of his house.When none of the neighbors want to believe in the existence of the beast, the old Viking decides to hunt the dragon that is stalking him.He is joined by Hiccup and friends to ensure Gobber's safe return.During the sea journey, they listen to more and more unbelievable stories about the rivalry between a Viking and a monster.Eventually, the travelers crash on Dragon Island, where they learn the truth about Gnatochrup.The animation is a continuation of the film "How to Train Your Dragon".In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Tomasz Traczyński, Mateusz Narloch, Grzegorz Drojewski and Julia Kamińska.

programs.title: Completement cramé
programs.desc: A widowed, wealthy Englishman, Andrew Blake (John Malkovich), goes to France, the homeland of his beloved wife.When he arrives at the stately mansion with a suitcase, to his surprise he is not mistaken for a guest, but a candidate for a butler.To stay as long as possible in the place where he met the love of his life years ago, he accepts a job offer and does not reveal the real destination of his trip to anyone.He meets the owner of the historic mansion, the widow Nathalie Beauvillier (Fanny Ardant), the housekeeper and cook Odile (Émilie Dequenne), the maid Manon (Eugénie Anselin) and the estate manager Philippe.Over time, he becomes friends with the residents and helps them look at their lives from a different perspective.Thanks to this, he also finds his lost joy and motivation to act.

programs.title: La grazia
programs.desc: The President of Italy (Toni Servillo) is at the end of his term.In six months, his political and social role will come to an end.At this time, the head of state faces moral dilemmas caused by the euthanasia regulations and the issue of pardoning two life sentences.Every decision will expose the politician to criticism, but it is up to him to decide which crime deserves forgiveness: an act of mercy or murder.Bending under the weight of responsibility, the statesman tries to buy time.At the same time, he struggles with personal problems.Despite the passage of 40 years, he still has not forgiven his deceased wife's betrayal, and he cannot find the way to his daughter (Anna Ferzetti).Ultimately, however, it proves that even if you know yourself perfectly, you can make a decision that will surprise everyone and bring inner freedom.

programs.title: BlacKkKlansman
programs.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

programs.title: Macbeth
programs.desc: Macbeth returns from his war expedition.The witches predict a great future for him.The man's ambition and lust for power awaken, additionally fueled by his wife.However, his path to the throne will be bloody.

programs.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programs.desc: London, 1970.Farrokh "Freddie" Bulsara (Rami Malek) works at Heathrow Airport.One day he meets Mary Austin (Lucy Boynton), who becomes his girlfriend.He also meets members of the band Smile - drummer Roger Taylor (Ben Hardy) and guitarist Brian May (Gwilym Lee).The musicians are looking for a new vocalist.It becomes Freddie.Additionally, bassist John Deacon (Joe Mazzello) joins the group.Some time later they record their debut album.Soon, Freddie changes the band's name to Queen and his surname to Mercury.The artists come under the wing of manager John Reid (Aidan Gillen) and release a new album, and then go on tour around the United States.Even though Freddie proposes to Mary, during the trip he begins to question his own sexuality.In 1975, the album "A Night at the Opera" was released, which included, among others:the song "Bohemian Rhapsody".The composition becomes the reason for the breakup with the current manager, but also makes the musicians real stars.

programs.title: Tripped Up
programs.desc: Lizzy (Leah Lewis) has always dreamed of becoming a chef.However, participating in a culinary reality show and later working in a New York restaurant became a source of frustration for her.A cooking enthusiast is one step away from giving up her greatest passion.The last chance to stay in the catering industry is to participate in a culinary festival.Together with her friends, Mary (Ashley Moore), Kai (Ariel Winter) and Taylor (Sasha Fox), she sets off on an adventure.If she fails, she is ready to look for another path in life.Unfortunately, the team has been plagued by bad luck since the beginning of the expedition.
